title: Socketed antler toggle harpoon head – a unique hunter-gatherer fishing implement in western Lithuania’s freshwater lake environment
version: Estonian Journal of Archaeology 28, pp. 3–28; CC BY 4.0 original; mapped excerpt
lineage: Original research on a later Lithuanian specimen. The sampled antler age is not an exact date of manufacture; the authors reconstruct rigging from morphology and comparative evidence, not an observed ancient catch.

passages.note: Printed pp. 8, 11–18 / excerpt pp. 2–10: specimen morphology, direct antler dating and proposed line-and-toggle mechanism.
